defect: Codex response_item/message text was silently omitted while tool records made the file appear healthy.

reproduction.input: 9 synthetic input_text user messages and 22 output_text assistant messages
reproduction.baseline: Pre-fix session_events.py from the Git index; same raw rows passed to both extractors.

covered: Real collection CLI on six isolated synthetic sessions, each with 9 user messages, 22 assistant messages and a paired tool call/result; all retained in evidence.json.
Legacy event_msg and response_item/message coexist; string bodies and text/input_text/output_text blocks are supported.
Source line, file, tool call ID and time-window boundaries are preserved; long event text is not truncated.
System/developer messages, injected blocks and media are excluded without swallowing an adjacent valid user request.
Unknown or malformed message content raises a dedicated diagnostic even when tool events survive; readable sibling blocks remain.
Unreadable messages without timestamps remain diagnostics rather than disappearing.

local_schema_spot_check.method: Read-only inspection of the six most recently modified local Codex session files; no raw text or paths saved here.
local_schema_spot_check.limitation: This sample was not identified as the six sessions cited in the bug report; injected user context is intentionally filtered.

limitations: Historical evidence snapshots were not rewritten or recollected.
This is script validation, not a new multi-turn writing evaluation.
